get_device_type: get the current GPU device type returning cuda, hip, or xpu from the active PyTorch installation
is_hip: check if the current PyTorch build was compiled with AMD ROCm HIP accelerator support
device_synchronize: synchronize the current GPU device across CUDA, XPU, or HIP as a cross-platform replacement for torch.cuda.synchronize
get_device_count: get the number of available GPU devices for the current device type cuda hip or xpu
check_allow_prequantized_models: check the ALLOW_PREQUANTIZED_MODELS boolean to see if pre-quantized models can be loaded on the current device
